title: Chicken en Mole Poblano

items: 3–4 garlic cloves, roughly chopped or minced

steps: Heat a shallow layer of oil in a very large skillet, or use two skillets. Brown the chicken on both sides, then add water to cover and simmer 30 minutes.
While the chicken cooks, blend all remaining ingredients except the bay leaf until smooth.

When the chicken is done, drain and reserve the broth. Add 1–1½ cups broth to the sauce and blend. Pour the sauce over the chicken in the skillet, add the bay leaf and cook over low heat for 35 minutes more.
